customManagers.description: Pinned tool versions annotated with `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` in workflows and the Dockerfile

Helm chart versions of management add-ons and their catalog/apps twins, annotated with `# renovate: datasource=... depName=... [registryUrl=...]` on the line above `version:` (catalog/core, catalog/apps, seed core-addons, Stage 0 Pulumi programs)

Container images pinned in Rust constants annotated with `// renovate: datasource=... depName=...` on the line above (the value may carry the image name: `"pulumi/pulumi:<version>-nonroot"` bumps only the tag)
